title: Rock Harbor Charter Boat Services

services.name: Sailing May-October
services.desc: The Rock Harbor Fishing fleet consists of fully equipped sport fishing charter boats that fish the waters of Cape Cod Bay for striped bass, bluefish and bonito. We also offer fishing for flounder, sea bass, tautog, bluefin tuna and sharks. All captains are knowledgeable, courteous and will do their best to accommodate the needs of both experienced and novice anglers alike.
